title: Depot
blurb: Replay of a recorded run: a builder agent's recorded run of a Rust inventory service and its browser client. Every recorded write is applied, and a recorded command runs again in a Workspace unless it repeats an earlier run on a Branch that has not changed since.

set -eo pipefail
layerfs() { node "$DSH_LAYERFS_CLI" "$@"; }
. "{{scenario}}/../shared/replay.sh"

keep sandbox-root "$sb"; echo "Sandbox $sb"
layerfs branch fork implementation | kind Forked
layerfs fs apply implementation -m 'M1 scaffold frozen four-package workspace, health and CLI' --from "{{scenario}}/changes/001.json" | kind Committed   # 29 change(s)

exit_is "$code" 0
